tools.name: calculate_mvp_timeline_roi
tools.description: Compares a Holston AI fixed-price 2–4 week build against a traditional ~6-month build. Returns build costs, labor savings captured, cost of delay, developer-weeks freed, payback week, and a month-by-month cumulative net position over the analysis window.

manual_process_hours_per_week.description: Hours per week your team currently spends on the manual process the software will replace.

dev_headcount.description: Number of in-house developers who would be assigned to a traditional build.

project_scope.description: Target project scope. Websites: website_launch (up to 5 pages, 5 days) | website_growth (up to 10 pages, 10 days) | website_commerce (online store, 15–20 days). Small app: small_app (2 wks). Apps & AI agents: lean (2 wks) | standard (3 wks) | complex (4 wks).

manual_hourly_cost_usd.description: Fully loaded hourly cost of the staff doing the manual work (default $45).

dev_annual_cost_usd.description: Fully loaded annual cost per in-house developer (default $150,000).

automation_rate.description: Fraction of the manual hours eliminated once the software is live, 0–1 (default 0.7).

holston_fixed_price_usd.description: A specific fixed-price quote from Holston AI. If omitted, the scope's standard starting price is used.

traditional_timeline_weeks.description: Delivery timeline of the traditional path in weeks (default: 6–12 for websites, 26 ≈ 6 months for apps/agents).

traditional_vendor_cost_usd.description: External agency/vendor spend on the traditional path, on top of in-house dev time (default 0).

holston_internal_involvement.description: Share of the in-house dev team's time needed during a Holston build, 0–1 (default 0.1).

analysis_horizon_months.description: Length of the comparison window in months (default 6).

tools.name: generate_boilerplate_schema
tools.description: Generates a production-ready Next.js App Router repository layout, Prisma schema, and PostgreSQL DDL for a business domain (b2b_saas, marketplace, healthcare_admin, logistics, restaurant_retail, professional_services, manufacturing). Multi-tenant by default with org membership and audit logging; optional agent-run tables.

domain.description: Business domain: b2b_saas | marketplace | healthcare_admin | logistics | restaurant_retail | professional_services | manufacturing.

output.description: What to generate: repo_layout | prisma | sql | all (default all).

include_ai_agents.description: Add AgentRun/ToolCall tables plus agent runtime and MCP directories (default true).

tools.name: audit_ai_visibility
tools.description: Audits a live public website and scores (0–100, grade A–F) how well AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) and search engines can find, read and cite it. Checks robots.txt rules for AI and search crawlers, server-rendered text, business and FAQ structured data, Open Graph, llms.txt, sitemap, HTTPS, mobile viewport and response time. Returns each check with a plain-English fix, the top 3 fixes, and a shareable report link. Takes up to ~20 seconds.

url.description: Website to audit, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/

tools.name: build_quote
tools.description: Builds an itemized Holston AI quote from fixed prices: one-time builds, monthly plans, first-year total (monthly plans have a 12-month minimum), timeline, terms, fitting add-ons, and a shareable link to the quote on holstonai.com. Ask what the customer needs first; do not add plans they did not ask for.

builds.description: One-time builds. website-starter (one page, 3 days) | website-launch (up to 5 pages, 5 days) | website-growth (up to 10 pages, CMS, 10 days) | website-commerce (online store, 15–20 days) | small-app (custom web app, 2 weeks) | ai-agent-mvp (AI agent or SaaS MVP, 2–4 weeks).

seo_plan.description: Monthly SEO + AEO plan: seo-essentials (local) | seo-growth (adds AI search / AEO) | seo-authority (adds links, PR, competitor tracking).

hosting.description: Monthly hosting: hosting-site (websites) | hosting-app (apps and agents).

care.description: Monthly service contract: care-site (websites) | care-app (apps and agents).

assessment.description: Systems & Data Health Check, a one-time fixed-price assessment by company size: assessment-small (up to 50 employees) | assessment-medium (51–200) | assessment-large (201–500). The fee is credited toward a project started within 60 days.

business_name.description: Customer or business name to show on the quote.

tools.name: build_systems_map
tools.description: Draws a map of a company's software systems and how data moves between them (automatic, manual, export/import), as a Mermaid diagram with a shareable link. Flags manual handoffs, the same data kept in several unsynced systems, hub systems many processes depend on, and systems with no connections. Use after interviewing the user about their systems; nothing is stored.

company.description: Company name, shown on the map.

category.description: What it is used for, e.g. CRM, accounting, inventory, ERP, e-commerce, support, HR, spreadsheet, custom database.

data.description: Kinds of data stored in it, e.g. customers, orders, invoices, products, employees. Use the same words across systems.

systems.description: Every software system, database or important spreadsheet the business uses.

from.description: Source system name (must match a system name).

to.description: Destination system name (must match a system name).

method.description: automatic = integration or sync | manual = someone re-types it | export_import = files exported and uploaded by hand | unknown

hours_per_week.description: Staff hours per week spent on this flow, if manual.

tools.name: calculate_manual_work_cost
tools.description: Calculates what manual, repetitive work caused by disconnected systems costs per year: staff hours, full-time equivalents, labor and error costs, five-year cost, and the savings from automating it. Input a list of tasks with hours per week; hourly cost is optional.

task.description: The manual task, e.g. 'Re-typing web orders into QuickBooks', 'Building the monthly sales report'.

hours_per_week.description: Total staff hours per week spent on this task, across everyone who does it.

hourly_cost_usd.description: Fully loaded hourly cost of the people doing it (wage plus benefits and taxes). Defaults to default_hourly_cost_usd.

error_cost_per_month_usd.description: Optional: estimated monthly cost of mistakes this task causes (wrong orders, billing errors, rework).

tasks.description: Each manual or repetitive task caused by disconnected systems.

default_hourly_cost_usd.description: Hourly cost used when a task has none (default $40).

automation_rate.description: Share of these hours that connecting the systems would remove, 0–1 (default 0.7).

tools.name: calculate_missed_call_cost
tools.description: Estimates the revenue a business loses each year to unanswered phone calls (missed calls, lost callers, lost customers, monthly and five-year loss) and how much an AI receptionist that answers every call could recover. Give calls per week (or missed calls per week) and the average job value; every other assumption has a sensible default.

missed_rate.description: Share of calls that go unanswered, 0–1 (default 0.25).

missed_per_week.description: Missed calls per week, if known. Overrides calls_per_week × missed_rate.

average_job_value_usd.description: Average revenue from a new customer's first job or purchase.

customer_lifetime_value_usd.description: Optional: total revenue from a typical customer over time. Used instead of the average job value.

new_caller_share.description: Share of missed callers who are new potential customers, 0–1 (default 0.5).

no_callback_rate.description: Share of those new callers who call a competitor instead of calling back, 0–1 (default 0.6).

close_rate.description: Share of new callers who become customers when answered, 0–1 (default 0.4).

recovery_rate.description: Share of lost calls an AI receptionist would handle, 0–1 (default 0.9).

tools.name: get_agent_templates
tools.description: Lists Holston AI's ready-built AI receptionist templates by industry (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, dental, law and more): the services, the questions the agent asks, the default call flow, optional steps, and emergency handling. Give an industry id for one template, or omit it for the list. Use it before design_ai_agent.

industry.description: Industry id. Omit to list all industries.

tools.name: design_ai_agent
tools.description: Designs an AI receptionist for a business from Holston AI's templates: the step-by-step call flow, what it does at any point (pricing questions, emergencies, transfers), and a link to holstonai.com where the owner can edit it and talk to the agent out loud in their browser for free. Only the industry and business name are required. Holston AI builds the real version on the business's phone line at a fixed price confirmed after a short call.

business_name.description: The business name the agent answers with.

city.description: Main service area, if it is one of these East Tennessee and Southwest Virginia cities.

services.description: Service ids from the template. Defaults to the template's main services.

pricing.description: How the agent answers pricing questions.

emergency_transfer.description: Transfer emergencies to an on-call number (default true where emergencies apply).

add_steps.description: Optional step ids to switch on, e.g. photos, returning, message.

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Reads a public website (homepage, sitemap and main pages) and writes a ready-to-upload llms.txt file that tells AI assistants who the business is, what it offers, where it works and which pages matter. Optional details (services, service area, hours, key facts) make it stronger. Use it when an audit shows no llms.txt.

business_name.description: Override the business name found on the site.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the business does, for whom, and where. Overrides the site's description.

services.description: Main services or products, one per item.

service_area.description: Where the business works, e.g. 'Kingsport, Johnson City and Bristol, TN'.

address.description: Street address, city, state and ZIP.

key_facts.description: Short facts AI assistants should know: years in business, licenses, starting prices, guarantees, awards.

tools.name: generate_business_schema
tools.description: Builds ready-to-paste Organization or LocalBusiness structured data (JSON-LD) with address, phone, hours, service area, services, social profiles and optional FAQs. If a website is given, details are pre-filled from it. Returns the <script> tag plus checks to fix before publishing. Use it when an audit shows missing business schema.

url.description: Business website. If given, details are pre-filled from the site.

business_type.description: The most specific schema.org type that fits, e.g. Plumber, Dentist, Restaurant, ProfessionalService. Default LocalBusiness.

days.description: Days with these hours: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.

social_profiles.description: Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Google Business Profile, Yelp and similar URLs.

faqs.description: Optional FAQs that appear visibly on the page; adds FAQPage markup.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Sends the user's contact details and project summary to Holston AI so the team can follow up. Before calling: collect name, email or phone, and a summary of what they need (include any quote or report links from this conversation), show the user exactly what will be sent, and get their explicit agreement. Never call it without that agreement or with made-up details.

email.description: Email address. Provide email, phone, or both.

company_size.description: Approximate number of employees, e.g. '25' or '51–200'.

interest.description: Main service they are interested in.

summary.description: What they need, in a few sentences: their situation, goals, timeline and anything already discussed (audit score, systems, budget).

quote_url.description: Instant quote link from build_quote, if one was created.

report_url.description: AI visibility report or systems map link, if one was created.

preferred_contact.description: How they prefer to be contacted.

best_time.description: Best days or times to reach them.

user_confirmed.description: Must be true. Only set it after showing the user exactly what will be sent and the user agreed to share it with Holston AI.
